thesis: A PURE-LATENCY A/B, the Track-2 half of the pair. The profiler puts the complex einsum's per-call strided WEIGHT copy (aten::copy_ on [4, 8, 12, 96, 1, 96], 16 calls) at 27.6 % of a Track-2 step -- a batch-1 disease, because that copy is O(1) in batch while the work it serves is O(batch). Pre-packing the weights once at load deletes it. The SAME switch is +1.6 % SLOWER on Track 1, which is why it ships on one board only
